2608.00122.title: Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot
2608.00122.paper_summary: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an ongoing production deployment of a shared organizational memory system that makes capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, gates obvious security and privacy risks, and retrieves memories for future agents. This short paper describes the deployed lifecycle and an operational snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation.
2608.00122.paper_summary_zh: 企業編碼代理依賴工具和檢索，但企業知識往往仍然不在公共訓練數據和正式文檔之外：內部DSL、專有平台、本地慣例、最近的修正和隱性工作流程。現有的知識介面暴露了存儲的資源，但仍然依賴於代理識別並明確記錄值得重用的教訓，將捕捉與編碼工作流程脫節，導致開發經驗重複被重新發現。我們報告了一個正在進行的共享組織記憶系統的生產部署，該系統使捕捉成為編碼工作的平台級部分：它收集與任務相關的經驗並獲得貢獻者的批准，將其策劃成可重用的問答記憶，控制明顯的安全和隱私風險，並為未來的代理檢索記憶。這篇短文描述了已部署的生命周期和運營快照。對檢索和編碼任務的影響仍在評估中。
2608.00122.author: Harsh Rao Dhanyamraju et.al.
